verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a silicon processor (SoC). Setting up autonomous background automations is a software or OS capability, so this axis is a category error for a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships any automation feature; the items cover only compute, GPU, Neural Engine, media engines and I/O performance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
